name: Compliance Summary
query:
SELECT
    'VAT Output' AS "Type::120",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vom.status = 'Approved' AND vom.vat_upload_success = 1 THEN 1 END) AS "Uploaded:Int:100",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vom.status = 'Approved' AND vom.vat_upload_success = 0 AND vom.transactionid != '' THEN 1 END) AS "Pending Upload:Int:120",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vom.status = 'To Be Reviewed' THEN 1 END) AS "Pending Review:Int:120",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vom.status = 'Rejected' THEN 1 END) AS "Rejected:Int:100",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total:Int:100"
FROM
    `tabVAT Output Metadata` vom
WHERE
    vom.docstatus = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'VAT Input' AS "Type::120",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vim.status = 'Approved' AND vim.vat_upload_success = 1 THEN 1 END) AS "Uploaded:Int:100",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vim.status = 'Approved' AND vim.vat_upload_success = 0 AND vim.transactionid != '' THEN 1 END) AS "Pending Upload:Int:120",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vim.status = 'To Be Reviewed' THEN 1 END) AS "Pending Review:Int:120",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN vim.status = 'Rejected' THEN 1 END) AS "Rejected:Int:100",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total:Int:100"
FROM
    `tabVAT Input Metadata` vim
WHERE
    vim.docstatus = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Withholding Tax' AS "Type::120",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN wtc.xml_export_status = 'Exported' THEN 1 END) AS "Uploaded:Int:100",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN wtc.status = 'Submitted' AND wtc.xml_export_status != 'Exported' AND wtc.transactionid != '' THEN 1 END) AS "Pending Upload:Int:120",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN wtc.status = 'Draft' THEN 1 END) AS "Pending Review:Int:120",
    0 AS "Rejected:Int:100",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total:Int:100"
FROM
    `tabWithholding Tax Certificate` wtc
WHERE
    wtc.docstatus = 0
